seo.title: Brunch Oceanside | The Lobby Tiki Bar | Saturday & Sunday
seo.description: Weekend brunch at The Lobby Tiki Bar in Oceanside CA. Saturday and Sunday 10 AM – 3 PM. Island-inspired brunch plates and tiki cocktails inside The Brick Hotel.

hero.label: Saturday & Sunday
hero.title: Brunch
hero.body: Island-inspired brunch plates and craft tiki cocktails every Saturday and Sunday. Inside The Brick Hotel on Pier View Way.

plates.label: The Kitchen
plates.title: Brunch Plates
plates.body: Island-inspired morning plates. Built for the atmosphere, designed to hold up against the rum program.

cocktails.label: Brunch Cocktails
cocktails.title: Tiki Before Noon
body: The full cocktail program runs through brunch. Painkillers, Mai Tais, and the Cobra Kai don't care what time it is. Neither should you.
Weekend brunch is the right time to start with a Lobby Mai Tai and see where the afternoon takes you.
